responsibility: Declares the value-profiling framework used by profile instrumentation and profile-use transformations. It defines histogram kinds and the histogram_value data structure, maps histogram types to gcov counters, and exposes APIs for finding values to profile, attaching/removing/duplicating statement histograms, running GIMPLE value-profile transformations, extracting common values, generating profiling instrumentation hooks, and streaming histogram data. This header is the public contract between profile.cc, tree profiling code, and value-prof.cc’s optimization logic.
same_name_distinction: This header defines the value-profiling framework interface, including histogram kinds, histogram_value data structures, counter mappings, and declarations for instrumentation and transformation helpers used by other profiling code. Unlike gcc/value-prof.cc, it does not implement statement scanning, histogram attachment behavior, or the actual GIMPLE transformations.
